info.name: Sidecar Audit Sidecar Audit API API
Trigger sidecar query audit search using various filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip.

params.name: from_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended before this time will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Default is 24 hours ago.

params.name: to_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended after this time will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Default is now.

params.name: consuming_user
params.description: The user that executed the query. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: consuming_user_email
params.description: The email of the user that executed the query. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: query_id
params.description: The ID of the query. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: sidecar_id
params.description: The ID of the sidecar that executed the query. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: sidecar_instance_id
params.description: The ID of the sidecar instance that executed the query. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: table_name
params.description: The name of the table that was queried. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: schema_name
params.description: The name of the schema that was queried. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: database_name
params.description: The name of the database that was queried. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: column_name
params.description: The name of the column that was queried. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: repo_name
params.description: The name of the repository (connection) the query ran against. Distinct from database_name, which matches the per-column database. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: statement_type
params.description: The type of the statement that was executed. Case-insensitive. Can be repeated for multiple values.

params.name: statement_text_contains
params.description: A string to search inside the executed statement. Case-insensitive.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The order by clause for the query. Case-insensitive.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The column to sort by. Case-insensitive.

items.docs:
This endpoint triggers a search for non-cdw query audits. Chaining query parameter filters as `AND` operations.
The `search_uuid` that is returned expires after 30 days.

info.name: Get the results of a search using the `search_uuid`.

params.name: search_uuid
params.description: `search_uuid` received by /audits endpoint.

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results returned.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves the results of a search using the `search_uuid` provided by the /audits endpoint. The results are paginated and can be retrieved using the `next_page_token` provided in the response.
